body:
Hi @iHamza14,

Thanks for asking! Here is what happened with the earlier run:

1. **Initial Run ([Run #42495764228](https://github.com/abdulhamid999/oppia/actions/runs/42495764228))**: All user actions and test assertions passed, but the run failed at the snapshot comparison (`toHaveScreenshot()`) because the legacy Puppeteer baseline snapshots used `1920x1080` desktop dimensions while Playwright uses `1280x720`. In Oppia's CI workflow, video recording artifacts are only uploaded when a test fails (`if: steps.run-acceptance-test.outcome == 'failure'`). That's why the recordings were captured in that run.
2. **Subsequent Green Runs**: Once we updated the baseline snapshots with the exact Playwright CI-generated images, the tests passed completely:
   - **Single Verification Run**: [Run #42497871340](https://github.com/abdulhamid999/oppia/actions/runs/42497871340) (100% green)
   - **200-Run Stress Test**: [Run #42498974451](https://github.com/abdulhamid999/oppia/actions/runs/42498974451) (Passed 100% — 203/203 jobs completed with 0 failures: 100 Desktop + 100 Mobile)
   Because both runs passed with 0 failures, CI did not upload video artifacts for those runs by default.
3. **100% Green Video Recording Run**: To provide video recordings from a completely passing run, I triggered a dedicated run:
   - **Video Recordings Workflow Run (100% Green)**: https://github.com/abdulhamid999/oppia/actions/runs/42559793875
     - `video-recordings_site-moderator_check-recent-feedback-messages-1-desktop`
     - `video-recordings_site-moderator_check-recent-feedback-messages-1-mobile`

Both Desktop and Mobile suites are fully green and stable. Could you please assign `site-moderator/check-recent-feedback-messages` to me so I can open the PR against `oppia:develop`? Thank you!
